scope.summary: Export erection and gape as BOTH pose assets and blendshapes per Section 13.26 (REQ-032, GREQ-034): the erection continuum ships as a bone-pose asset set on the genital chains AND as baked blendshapes per profile, gape states likewise, so engine logic can drive arousal states through either mechanism (SOS rigid/floppy switching precedent).
acceptance_criteria: Erection exports as (a) pose assets sampling the continuum on the penis chain (at minimum flaccid/half/full keys) and (b) baked blendshapes per sample, in both glTF and FBX-bridge lanes.
Vulva/anus gape states export in the same dual form including the extreme-gape range (REQ-031 bar).
An equivalence fixture verifies both forms deform the mesh identically within tolerance at each sampled state (pose-driven vs blendshape-driven vertex positions).

Exported state metadata (sidecar) names the states and their rigid|floppy physics intent so game logic can switch per scene (GREQ-034); modular-attachment exports (MT-613 counterpart lane) carry the same states.
scope.risk_if_missed: Arousal states become render-only tricks that die on export — the single most-used adult animation control ships unusable in Blender/UE, forcing users back to modding-ecosystem hacks.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
